# Phase 6 Settings Checklist: QuickFlow Personal Productivity Workspace

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality check for the Phase 6 (User Story 6 - Navigate and set preferences) acceptance criteria AS1-AS3, FR-028, FR-029 and SC-006 used by loop-3 testing: persistent navigation, settings fields and validation, default landing view, notification preferences and browser permission.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (testing loop), focus US6 acceptance criteria + settings API validation + landing view + notification preferences.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are default values for every setting (display name, in-app, browser notifications, default view) specified for first run? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the set of selectable default views enumerated, and is it stated whether Settings itself may be a landing page? [Completeness, Spec §US6 AS2]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified whether the display name is trimmed before the 1-80 length rule is applied? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified whether settings are saved as a whole (single save) or per field (auto-save)? [Gap, Spec §US6 AS2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a success confirmation requirement defined for saving settings? [Gap, Spec §US6 AS2]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the notification events governed by the notification preferences listed (plan start only, or also other events)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, §FR-029]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "highlights the current page" defined with an observable, accessible indicator (e.g., current-page state, not color only)? [Clarity, Spec §US6 AS1]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "applied" defined for each preference (where the display name appears, when the default view is used, which notifications are suppressed)? [Clarity, Spec §US6 AS2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it clear whether the default view applies only when opening the app root or also after other entry URLs? [Ambiguity, Spec §US6 AS2]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "one click from any page" defined for narrow layouts where navigation may be collapsed? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, §FR-032]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the six page names identical across FR-028, US6 AS1 and the default-view list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the in-app notification preference consistent with FR-023, which mandates an in-app start notification? [Conflict, Spec §FR-023, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the display-name rule (1-80) consistent between FR-029 and the API contract schema? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can "persist across restarts" be objectively verified (backend restart vs browser reload)? [Measurability, Spec §US6 AS2]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-006 measurable for every page pair (6 × 6) rather than from a single page? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for invalid settings input (blank, too long, missing field, unknown view) and the error shown? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK017 Is app behavior specified when settings cannot be loaded at startup (backend unavailable)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK018 Is behavior specified when browser notifications are enabled while permission is already denied or the browser lacks notification support? [Coverage, Spec §US6 AS3]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it specified whether the browser-notification preference stays on (saved) after permission is denied? [Ambiguity, Spec §US6 AS3]
- [ ] CHK020 Is discarding unsaved changes (reset / leaving the page) addressed? [Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Is the both-notifications-off case specified (no plan-start signal at all, highlight only)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK022 Are display names containing only whitespace or exactly 80 characters after trim addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-029]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Are accessibility requirements for the settings toggles (role, accessible name, keyboard operation) specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK024 Is a response-time target for saving settings stated? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption of a single local user (one settings record) documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the dependency on browser Notification permission APIs and their availability documented? [Dependency, Spec §US6 AS3]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- Items are left unchecked; review belongs to the reviewer.
